name: deliveryos
description: DeliveryOS monorepo root — repo-level quality gate and tooling orchestration (no workspaces: each app manages its own dependencies)

scripts.verify: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:web && npm run verify:mobile
scripts.verify:backend: npm run typecheck --prefix services/backend_api && npm run lint --prefix services/backend_api && npm run test:unit --prefix services/backend_api && npm run build --prefix services/backend_api
scripts.verify:web: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/admin_portal && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/vendor_portal
scripts.verify:mobile: cd apps/customer_app && flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test && cd ../rider_app && flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test
